After Orpah returns, Naomi again urges Ruth to go back, setting up Ruth’s direct answer in verse 16. Earlier departure advice is related and should be linked rather than counted as another generic principle.

A direction recorded in this narrative. Its original speaker, recipient and occasion must be retained; recording an order does not establish that God approves it or commands every believer to repeat it. The narrator’s seven-day reference in 13:8 explicitly points back to Samuel’s direction in 10:8. In 13:13 Samuel calls the breached command his commandment that the Lord commanded Saul. Retain the original direction as the primary source and link the later attribution.

Link this parallel instance to the existing record without merging the incidents. Adds 26:10–11: David restates the prohibition and orders, ‘take the spear… and the water flask, and let us go.’
